questions.question: When alley docking, what should you do first?

options.text: Position your vehicle directly in front of the alley.
Back up directly in front of the alley.
Stop parallel to the outer edge of the alley.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop parallel to the outer edge of the alley.
questions.explanation: For alley docking, drive past the alley first. Stop your vehicle parallel to the outer edge. Then back your vehicle straight into the alley parking space.

questions.question: During the basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Drive straight into a parking space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parallel park.
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: During the basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Pull forward into a parking space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parallel park.
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: When taking the on-road driving test, which is NOT required?

options.text: Complete the test without an accident.
Show you can use your cell phone while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Show you can use your cell phone while driving.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, you must drive safely and responsibly. You must wear your safety belt, obey all traffic signs and laws, and complete the test without accidents or moving violations.

questions.question: When exiting your vehicle, you:

options.text: Must keep four points of contact with the vehicle.
May turn to face the road before completely exiting.
Must face away from the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must face the vehicle.
questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. On a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may result in automatic failure.

questions.question: When operating a school bus, when should mirrors be adjusted?
questions.correctAnswerText: Before beginning to drive.
questions.explanation: Proper mirror adjustment is critical for safe school bus operation. Always check each mirror before you start driving.

questions.question: During the on-road driving skills test, you will be evaluated on gear usage. You should NOT:

options.text: Select a gear that over-revs the engine.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift while turning.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving skills test, use a gear that does not over-rev or under-rev the engine. Avoid grinding gears and avoid shifting while turning or going through intersections.

questions.question: When asked to change lanes during the driving test, you should:

options.text: Use your turn signal and change lanes when it is safe.
Change lanes quickly, even if it means cutting off another driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your turn signal and change lanes when it is safe.
questions.explanation: When the examiner asks you to change lanes, check for traffic and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a backing maneuver in the basic control skills test?
questions.correctAnswerText: Blind offset
questions.explanation: Backing maneuvers in the basic vehicle control skills test include straight line backing, offset back/right, offset back/left, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: While students load and unload a bus, the driver should:

options.text: Watch the students and the loading and unloading process.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch the students and the loading and unloading process.
questions.explanation: The bus driver must watch students as they board and exit to make sure they do not get caught in doors or handrails. Make sure students move a safe distance away from the bus after exiting.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stop ahead, what should you do?

options.text: Talk to the students on the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slowly.
questions.explanation: Always approach a school bus stop slowly and carefully.

questions.question: A school bus has a blind spot that extends at least ____ behind it.
questions.correctAnswerText: 50 feet
questions.explanation: School buses have blind spots below the side mirrors, in front of the side mirrors, and directly behind the rear bumper. The blind spot behind a bus usually extends 50 to 150 feet, but can be as far as 400 feet on longer buses.

questions.question: How should students safely leave a school bus?

options.text: Stay seated until the driver tells them it is safe to exit.
Stand up and walk to the door while the bus is slowing down.
Exit the bus and stand next to it while it is driving away from the stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay seated until the driver tells them it is safe to exit.
questions.explanation: Students must stay seated until the driver says it is safe to exit. After exiting, they should walk at least 10 feet away from the bus so the driver can see them clearly.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror located on a school bus?

options.text: On the outside left of the bus.
On the outside right of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side inside the bus.

questions.question: During the basic control skills test, you lose points when you:

options.text: Cross over an exercise boundary line.
Exit the vehicle once to check your position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross over an exercise boundary line.
questions.explanation: The examiner counts each time your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line. Each time counts as an error against your score.

questions.question: Backing a school bus is:
questions.correctAnswerText: Strongly discouraged.
questions.explanation: Avoid backing a school bus whenever possible. Only back up if there is no safe alternative, and always follow proper safety steps.

questions.question: What do the outside crossover mirrors let you see?

options.text: The right side of the bus
The left side of the bus

questions.correctAnswerText: The front bumper
questions.explanation: Crossover mirrors help you see the danger zone in front of the bus, and the danger zones on the left and right sides from the front of the bus to the service door.

questions.question: When should a bus start moving after students have boarded?

options.text: As soon as students are through the door
When students are walking to their seats
When all students are seated and looking forward
As soon as students cross the standee line

questions.correctAnswerText: When all students are seated and looking forward
questions.explanation: Wait until all passengers are seated and looking forward before moving the bus.

questions.question: When checking the fifth wheel gap during a pre-trip inspection, what should you look for?

options.text: A gap between the kingpin and the locking jaws.
The locking jaws are fully closed around the kingpin.

questions.correctAnswerText: The locking jaws are fully closed around the kingpin.
questions.explanation: When inspecting the tractor and trailer connection, check that the locking jaws are fully closed around the kingpin.

questions.question: During the pre-trip vehicle inspection test, which is true?

options.text: You do not need to identify the ABS.
You do not need to check the windshield wipers.
You only need to check shock absorbers on one axle.
You must check the steering box for leaks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must check the steering box for leaks.
questions.explanation: During the pre-trip inspection, check that the steering box is secure and not leaking.
